# §0/1–§5→0 — The Immutable Subject

## #0 — The act of denial appears

The input is a claim concerning the cessation or absence of the subject. The operation asks what makes that claim available as a claim. If the claimed cessation is known, the knowing presupposes a witness-position. If it is not known, no report of that cessation has thereby been established.

The [Binary Explication](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-binary-explication/taylor-2026-binary-explication.md), File 1's opening and return, sources this argument. Immutability concerns the subject-position presupposed by perception, doubt, denial, and recognition. It does not assert the permanence of a personality, biography, or mental state. [The subject-logics root](../../subject-logics.md) gathers the complete relation.

## #1 — Fact and contents

A thought about awareness, a body-image, a feeling of ownership, or the sense of being a witness can each become a content. Examining such a content yields something appearing; the fact of its appearing remains implicated in the examination. Refinement of the content can make the account more accurate without changing those offices into one another.

[C01](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C01-Subject-Defined-Indefinability.md) defines the canonical subject distinction. [A01](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A01-Subject-God-and-Faithful-Definition.md) embodies the performed return through its own defining act. A technical system's production of a self-report concerns the content it produces; it does not by itself settle the fact-question of phenomenal localisation.

## #2 — The apparent subject has an instrument

The native assignments are:

| Sign | Office in this traversal |
|---|---|
| 0 | Unobjectifiable subject-position |
| Ø | Apparent subject in which the inner instrument is fused with the subject-office |
| X | Object-field articulated through the instrument |
| 1 | Integrated unity in the core §IX recognition sequence |
| Ø/X | Instrument recognised as medium between apparent subject and object-field |
| (0/Ø)/(1/X) | Subject-side and object-side recognition held in one field |

The *antaḥkaraṇa* names the inner instrument whose operations include determination, appropriation, and coordination. The source's point is exact: what can be noticed as an operation belongs to the field being known. It cannot assume the subject-office simply by being internal.

## #3 — The charitable cogito

File 1's opening reads Descartes as correctly encountering indubitable presence in thinking, doubting, or being deceived. Its objection concerns the identification that follows: the I can be gathered too quickly into thought's operation. “I am aware of thinking” opens the relation again. Thought becomes explicit as means; awareness remains the fact in which thinking is given.

This is the author's Argued reading. [A34](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A34-Idealism-Order-of-Dependence.md) retains the order of dependence despite misinterpretations of what occupies the knowing positions. The [core-theorems house](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md), CT-11–CT-16, distinguishes the native crossed-zero derivation from its companion cogito interpretation and historical source tasks.

## #4 — The field becomes available

At `(0/Ø)/(1/X)`, the upper relation distinguishes unoccluded subject-position from apparent subject, while the lower relates integrated unity to the cut object-field. The outer slash gives their shared field of availability. This is a local symbol assignment: `X` here names the object-field, distinct from the capacity-office it bears in the native `X/x` determination.

The full core §IX sequence continues through integrated `1` and returns as `0/1`. The [A/C conjugate root](../../../section-rooms/arguments/conjugate/AC.md) extends what this recognition changes in the relation between fact and account. Neither more internal components nor a more complete description can replace the recognition by adding another object to the inventory.

## #5→0 — A defined instrument, an unobjectified subject

The result preserves the instrument's real functions while distinguishing them from the condition in which they are known. File 1's short-chain return reaches conscious circumstance with that distinction active. Its flagged *isoid* coinage names signs functioning as entity and operation in the native development; the coinage supplies no separate external theorem about subjectivity.

This projection returns-to [A03](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A03-Immutable-Gap-Formal-Limit.md), [A18](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md), and [Movement16, Crossed Zero](../../../section-rooms/02-return-of-zero/movements/16-s1-p3-crossed-zero.md). The subject-position remains unobjectified through the very operations that make its instrument increasingly legible.
